messages.summary:
## Objective
- “Continue where you left off and finish the game.” Complete the existing 3D forest survival game into a playable game.

## Requirements
- Build request; do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at finish.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Assumed the game should retain its existing 99-night survival premise and added keyboard controls and a strike action alongside the existing mobile controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Installed dependencies with `npm install`; `npm run build` succeeded before the latest source edits.
- Ran the game in Playwright and confirmed the page loaded without console errors; saved and inspected `screenshots/initial.jpg` and `screenshots/playing.jpg`.
- Added keyboard movement, strike UI/control markup, warm player lantern, strike arc, smoke/fire visuals, and HUD health ratio updates.

### Active
- Finish wiring the strike mechanic and remaining gameplay polish.
- Rebuild and test the updated game; verify gameplay and capture a latest JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Strike-related state and visuals were added, but there is no `attack()` implementation yet; keyboard Space and the attack button currently reference a missing function.

## Next Move
1. Implement `attack()` to strike nearby enemies in front of the player, with cooldown, damage, enemy defeat/respawn, and visible strike feedback.
2. Finish wiring attack timer, smoke animation, and night/game reset behavior; check mobile pointer input and HUD.
3. Add styling for `#attackBtn`, `#desktopHelp`, and the health panel indicator in `src/style.css`.
4. Run `npm run build`, then browser-test controls/gameplay and save/read only the latest compact JPEG.
5. Summarize assumptions and test results for the user.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Three.js scene and game logic; recent edits have left attack references unresolved.
- `src/style.css`: HUD and overlay styling; needs styling for newly added attack/help elements.
- `index.html`: Game interface; includes new `#attackBtn` and `#desktopHelp`.
- `package.json`: Vite build/dev scripts and Three.js dependency.
- `screenshots/playing.jpg`: Earlier screenshot, taken before recent changes.

## Important Context
- Earlier browser test loaded the title screen and started the game; Playwright reported zero errors and some warnings.
- Vite was launched on port 3002; the server may or may not still be running.
- Changes are uncommitted. `npm install` updated local dependencies; latest edits were not yet rebuilt or verified.

- Finish the existing 3D forest survival game as a playable 99-night survival game.

- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at finish.

- Retain the 99-night survival premise; support keyboard controls and a strike action alongside mobile controls.
